statement: let L := fun n : ℕ => if n=0 then (0:ℝ) else (-1:ℝ)^n.primeFactorsList.length; let C := fun n : ℕ => (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, L t * L (n-t))/(n:ℝ); ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (∑ p ∈ N.divisors.filter Nat.Prime, (C (N/p)-C N)^2/((p:ℝ)-1)) ≤ ((N-1:ℕ):ℝ)/(N:ℝ)-(C N)^2

plain_statement.en: New route · Dilation of Liouville correlations · LD-8003 · Bound simultaneous prime-dilation deviations by the variance

brief.zh: 对 p·1_{p∣t}−1 使用 LD-8001 和 LD-8002。将平方范数展开，有限样本中 t=0 的贡献为零，其余为 1。
brief.en: Use LD-8001 and LD-8002 for the centered indicators. Expand the squared norm. The squared endpoint term is zero and every other squared term is one.
